## Breaking changes

- `size` is now required and accepts only `1254x1254`, `1536x1024`, `1024x1536`, `1448x1086`, `1086x1448`, `1672x941`, and `941x1672`. `auto` and other sizes are rejected. Pick the size with the closest aspect ratio and resize the output locally. (#108)
- Images are now generated through the Codex Images endpoints (`images/generations` and `images/edits`) instead of the hosted `image_generation` tool on the Codex Responses endpoint. The Images endpoints return `imagegen_premium` in the `x-codex-active-limit` response header with a 1-day window, while the Responses endpoint returned `premium` with a 7-day window. No change to your usage is needed. (#115)
- The `quality` argument is removed, because the backend ignores it and picks the quality by itself. A `quality` value passed by an older caller is ignored. Remove it from your prompts and agent instructions. (#116)
- `images` now accepts at most five reference images. A call with six or more fails before any request is sent. (#117)
